Good understanding of backup and disaster recovery technologies, especially Veeam Backup & Replication in Hyper-V environments (backup server/proxy rebuilds, repositories, restore testing). Strong experience in Windows Server administration (2016/2019/2022/2025), including Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and Group Policy management.
